information_flow: The first call alone receives all common external inputs and encapsulates their relevant evidence and provenance in one complete executable policy state without separating contract and behavior authority. The terminal call consumes only that state, exercises indivisible authority over the complete artifact, and emits one policy.
name: Single-Ingress Indivisible State Authority
organization: two-call sequential lineage with one exclusive executable-state handoff

calls.objective: Receive the supplied evidence once, form one complete executable policy state retaining the provenance needed for downstream judgment, avoid imposing an immutable contract-versus-behavior authority partition, and pass the state as the sole downstream evidence carrier.
Consume only encapsulate_complete_evidence_state, jointly adjudicate public-contract conformance and behavior-bearing semantics from its contained evidence, and emit one complete policy.
